_preparation_supplies: F47 finite personal preparation bundles, paid with the existing once-per-character Master chest receipt. Raw materials cover five-creature Harness/Charm sets upgraded to +1, five feasts, station attachments and a forward camp with preparation reserve; Meadows is split across its two Masters. Players still refine and craft at their real home stations. Further upgrades, extra equipment, traits and repeatable training retain their gathering costs. Shared nodes and respawn clocks are unchanged. This is source tuning, not a measured route or C2 result.

_f47_0_dormant_clear_time_proposal.status: descriptive_only; not read by Master reward staging; F47#0 and owner play confirmation remain open
_f47_0_dormant_clear_time_proposal.intent: Move optional +1 Harness/Charm raw materials from once-per-character Master chests onto authored regional gathering; keep live grants unchanged until historical chest replay compatibility and normal-route time are proved.

sign_presentation._why_visible_range: Stormwood GPU pass (22 Oct 2026, F10#2 asks): with no draw distance the signpost text floated in the sky beside the enemy panel in Capacitor Grove fights 30+ m away. The words fade out past visible_range_m over fade_margin_m; the pole, lead NPC and prompts are unchanged. 0 = unlimited.

_why_departure_guidance: Coordinator ruling 2026-10-11: an L20 team that beats the Warden reaches Tidewake (rec. Lv 30) at cap 20, because the chapter route never sends the player to the second Meadows Master. Guidance only, never a gate: the quest log shows this step before the departure row, and the arch adds a notice, only while no owned creature has reached min_cap.

departure_guidance.label: Train with Mira Emberlane to raise your team's cap to 30.
departure_guidance.how: Recommended before Tidewake: win Mira Emberlane's one-creature duel in Meadows, open her chest, cook an Ascension Feast at home and feed it.

departure_guidance.label: Train with Ione Tideglass to raise your team's cap to 40.
departure_guidance.how: Recommended before Cloudreach: win Ione Tideglass's one-creature duel in Tidewake, open her chest, cook an Ascension Feast at home and feed it.

departure_guidance.label: Train with Aster Windward to raise your team's cap to 50.
departure_guidance.how: Recommended before Stormwood: fly to Aster Windward's perch in Cloudreach, win the one-creature duel, open the chest, cook an Ascension Feast at home and feed it.

_why_chapter_guidance: Coordinator ruling 2026-10-13 (progression decision a): the earned F49 chain reached Marrow at cap 40 because nothing signposts the chapter Masters (PROGRESSION §4, TRAINING §3: off the main path but signposted). Same state-derived advice as departure_guidance, inside a chapter: a quest-log row while `after_flag` is set, `until_flag` is not, and no owned creature has reached min_cap. Never a gate.

chapter_guidance.label: Train with Orin Stonewake to raise your team's cap to 20.
chapter_guidance.how: Before the Warrens, follow the Old Quarry haul road to Orin's side arena. Win his one-creature duel, open the recipe chest, then cook a matching Ascension Feast at your homestead Kitchen and feed it.

chapter_guidance.label: Train with Mira Emberlane to raise your team's cap to 30.
chapter_guidance.how: Before the Sigil gate, find Mira's side arena on the Ironwood ridge. Win her one-creature duel, open the recipe chest, then cook a matching Ascension Feast at your homestead Kitchen and feed it.

chapter_guidance.label: Train with Ione Tideglass to raise your team's cap to 40.
chapter_guidance.how: Before Veilfall, take Reedhaven's sheltered crossing to Ione's side arena on Gull Rest. Win her one-creature duel, open the recipe chest, then cook a matching Ascension Feast at your homestead Kitchen and feed it.

chapter_guidance.label: Train with Aster Windward to raise your team's cap to 50.
chapter_guidance.how: Before the summit approach, fly to Aster's High Perches side arena. Win his one-creature duel, open the recipe chest, then cook a matching Ascension Feast at your homestead Kitchen and feed it.

chapter_guidance.label: Train with Rowan Stormwise to raise your team's cap to 60.
chapter_guidance.how: Recommended before Deepwood: Rowan Stormwise waits by the Capacitor Grove on the Conductor Run. A cap-50 team can win the one-creature duel; open the chest, cook an Ascension Feast at home and feed it.
